causal_hypothesis: Front target proposal reaches measured pregrasp; fresh wrist upper-tube observations then condition a side grasp. Component CAD hulls preserve inter-part voids; measured empty wrist self points prevent false robot obstacles.

critic_rules.proposal: Interrupt the initial hold to enter the frozen pregrasp commissioning recovery.
critic_rules.title: Supervised pregrasp commissioning request

mechanism_change: Two fresh model proposals with camera and measured surface scope fixed in the bundle, metric transfer unchanged, full engage preview on the second proposal.

recovery_rules.fallback: Record failure and end the attempt. Use existing verified homing/unload cleanup; do not bypass review or silently switch engines.
recovery_rules.precondition: Supervised empty open start with fresh observed pink target.
safety_constraints: Only the gateway executes motor targets.
Fresh single-use tokens, joint limits and step budgets are enforced.
No automatic opening if current suggests an object may be held.
TCP clearance is not a full arm/finger collision certificate.
Dedicated supervised commissioning tests the unverified transfer; no VLA continuation.

steps.stop_when: Fresh feedback settles at the already requested start pose before learned proposal.
Fresh pink target cloud and metric proposal are recorded.
Fresh same-target joint IK and TCP clearance are eligible.
Measured TCP reaches pregrasp; sent commands and feedback are recorded separately.
Fresh cross-view-identified upper pink tube surface is recorded; no completed depth.
The same learned pose has reviewed pregrasp and engage sweeps.
Measured second learned pregrasp reaches its reviewed pose.
Fresh scene and measured phase prerequisites admit the same selected learned candidate.
Measured TCP reaches reviewed goal; lift requires target-specific contact.
Measured settled closure with the configured +0.9 preload.
Fresh scene and measured phase prerequisites admit the same selected learned candidate.
Measured TCP reaches reviewed goal; lift requires target-specific contact.
Pink tube lifted at least 1cm for five fresh measured frames.
Same-target measured pregrasp, healthy sensors and critic clearance permit reentry.
One bounded fresh VLA chunk or runtime terminal verdict.

recovery_rules.stop_condition: Only measured pink lift held five fresh frames is success; retain enable on failure or held object.
recovery_rules.title: Reacquire the observed pink target

validation_plan: Supervised frozen full learned grasp commissioning; no VLA or promotion until actual target retention and lift are accepted.
